question_variants: what share of orders come back
sql:
SELECT FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y-%m', o.created_at) AS month,
  COUNT(*) AS orders,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNTIF(o.status = 'Returned') / COUNT(*), 2) AS order_return_rate_pct
FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.orders` AS o
GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
report: Order-level return rate, distinct from the item-level metric. An order of four items with one return counts fully here and as 25% there. Always state which one is being reported.
